reconciliation_narrative.default: Reconciliation narrative: Raw roster contains 2,836 participant rows (2,833 valid staged/canonical records and 3 quarantined records with arrival at or after departure). The planning narrative assumption expected 2,400 participants (+436 over narrative). The 38 contingent colleges declared a total strength of 2,842 (-6 gap vs raw total of 2,836).
